description: This file defines the SiloControl class in the Orleans distributed application framework, responsible for managing silo operations such as gathering statistics, controlling activations, and executing control commands.

classes.name: SiloControl
classes.description: A class responsible for managing various operational aspects of a silo in Orleans, including statistics, control commands, and grain management.

methods.name: Ping
methods.description: Responds with a simple ping message to confirm liveness.

methods.name: ForceGarbageCollection
methods.description: Triggers garbage collection on the silo.

methods.name: ForceActivationCollection
methods.description: Forces collection of inactive grain activations based on age limit.

methods.name: ForceRuntimeStatisticsCollection
methods.description: Triggers a refresh of runtime statistics across the cluster.

methods.name: GetRuntimeStatistics
methods.description: Retrieves current runtime statistics of the silo.

methods.name: GetDetailedGrainStatistics
methods.description: Gets detailed statistics for grains, optionally filtered by types.

methods.name: GetSimpleGrainStatistics
methods.description: Returns simple grain statistics for the silo.

methods.name: GetDetailedGrainReport
methods.description: Provides a detailed report for a specific grain ID, including location and properties.

methods.name: GetActivationCount
methods.description: Returns the number of active grain activations in the silo.

methods.name: SendControlCommandToProvider
methods.description: Sends a control command to a specified grain provider.

methods.name: SetCompatibilityStrategy
methods.description: Sets the compatibility strategy for grain interface versions.

methods.name: SetCompatibilityStrategy
methods.description: Sets the compatibility strategy for a specific grain interface type.

methods.name: SetSelectorStrategy
methods.description: Sets the version selector strategy for a specific interface type.

methods.name: GetActiveGrains
methods.description: Returns a list of active grains of a particular type.

methods.name: MigrateRandomActivations
methods.description: Migrates a specified number of activations to a target silo, selecting randomly.
